name: 鹿鼎天下 (in-game: 雄霸天下『西安站』)
english_description: From the "Deer and Cauldron World.rar" archive within a 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib collection. Part of the "Century (Shiji) / adm-single" engine family (sharing lineage with this project's shiji, shujian2008, xjcq2000, xkxz2, and xiakexing100), itself descended from ES II. Curiously, the archive itself is named "Deer and Cauldron World," but the login banner actually brands the game "Xiongba Tianxia (Hero's Dominion), Xi'an Station," while the quit message says "you have left Deer and Cauldron World" — both names linger in the code, suggesting an incomplete rebrand at some point in its history.
